title_en: Fall 2026 Blue Lighthouse (푸른등대) Donation Scholarship: Second Round of New Recipient Selection
summary: The department has posted an announcement about the second round of selection for new recipients of the Blue Lighthouse (푸른등대) Donation Scholarship for Fall 2026. Only the title of the notice was available; it gives no eligibility rules, deadlines, application method or location. Students who are interested should read the full original notice or contact the department office; the contact details are in the original notice.
steps: Read the full original notice on the department academic board, as only its title was available for this translation.
If anything is unclear, contact the department office; the contact details are in the original notice.
translation:
